title: Photon energy from frequency
references: Griffiths, D. J. and Schroeter, D. F., Introduction to Quantum Mechanics, 3rd ed., Cambridge University Press (2018)
CODATA 2022 value of the Planck constant (exact in the 2019 SI), https://physics.nist.gov/cgi-bin/cuu/Value?h
validity_domain: Energy E = h f of one photon of frequency f in vacuum (Planck-Einstein relation).
limitations: Energy of a single photon, not of a beam: a beam carries N times this energy
The frequency is the one of the photon in the frame of the observer
The 0.5 % tolerance covers the rounding of a stated figure, it is not a physical uncertainty
